```{r}
# borrow_count的圖
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)


# p1
df_r2 <- metrics_summary_min %>%
  filter(target == "borrow_count") %>%
  arrange(desc(R2_pooled))

ggplot(df_r2, aes(x = reorder(station, R2_pooled), y = R2_pooled)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#3A6EA5") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "各站點 RF 模型 R²（borrow_count）",
       x = "站點",
       y = "R²") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)


# p2a
df_mae <- metrics_summary_min %>%
  filter(target == "borrow_count")

ggplot(df_mae, aes(x = station, y = MAE_weighted)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#F2B880") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "各站點 MAE（borrow_count）",
       x = "站點",
       y = "MAE（平均誤差台數）") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)


# p2b
ggplot(df_mae, aes(x = reorder(station, MAE_weighted), y = MAE_weighted)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#F2A649") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "各站點 MAE（borrow_count）",
       x = "站點",
       y = "MAE（平均預測錯誤台數）") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)


# p3
df_avg <- df_merged %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  summarise(avg_borrow = mean(borrow_count, na.rm = TRUE))

df_r2_join <- df_r2 %>% left_join(df_avg, by = "station")

ggplot(df_r2_join, aes(x = avg_borrow, y = R2_pooled)) +
  geom_point(color = "#6A4C93", size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "gray40") +
  labs(
    title = "R² vs 平均借車量",
    x = "平均借車量（每小時）",
    y = "R²"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# 只取 borrow_count，順便排除 NA

df_borrow <- metrics_summary_min %>%
filter(target == "borrow_count",
!is.na(R2_pooled),
!is.na(MAE_weighted))

# p1：各站點 R²（bar chart）

ggplot(df_borrow,
aes(x = reorder(station, R2_pooled), y = R2_pooled)) +
geom_col(fill = "#3A6EA5") +
coord_flip() +
labs(
title = "各站點 RF 模型 R²（borrow_count）",
x = "站點",
y = "R²"
) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# p2：各站點 MAE（bar chart）

ggplot(df_borrow,
aes(x = reorder(station, MAE_weighted), y = MAE_weighted)) +
geom_col(fill = "#F2A649") +
coord_flip() +
labs(
title = "各站點 MAE（borrow_count）",
x = "站點",
y = "MAE（平均預測錯誤台數）"
) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# p3：R² vs 平均借車量（scatter）

df_avg_borrow <- df_merged %>%
group_by(station) %>%
summarise(avg_borrow = mean(borrow_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

df_r2_join_borrow <- df_borrow %>%
left_join(df_avg_borrow, by = "station")

ggplot(df_r2_join_borrow,
aes(x = avg_borrow, y = R2_pooled)) +
geom_point(color = "#6A4C93", size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "gray40") +
labs(
title = "R² vs 平均借車量（borrow_count）",
x = "平均借車量（每小時）",
y = "R²"
) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

ggplot(df_pred, aes(x = actual, y = predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red") +
  labs(title="Actual vs Predicted Borrow Count",
       x="Actual", y="Predicted") +
  theme_minimal()



ggplot(df_pred, aes(x = residual)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill="#F2A649", color="white") +
  labs(title="Residual Distribution", x="Residual", y="Count") +
  theme_minimal()



ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = datetime)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = actual), color="black") +
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted), color="blue") +
  labs(title="Actual vs Predicted (Station X)",
       y="Borrow Count") +
  theme_minimal()



importance(rf_model)

varImpPlot(rf_model)

```
